description: Serve Qwen3-ASR over the realtime transcription WebSocket: server-side per-utterance endpointing + one whole-buffer generate() per closed utterance, each bounded by a length-proportional decode budget with a degenerate-output guard (v3, after the mruu field report: auto-language Czech fed a repetition spiral — 8192-token default, 32k chars, 135 s stall, silent UI). Measured ~1 s commits, text identical to the file endpoint. Reference implementation of the UP-11 escalation. Gates strict against omlx engine/stt.py at the 165be1ff era — older/newer bases refuse honestly and await a rebased version.
